title: Records List Types: overview film
description: Cards, tables and teasers in the Records module. A narrated tour, recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab, with English captions.
alt: Overview film, 53 seconds: Records List Types for TYPO3 v14. The core list, one click away; Long lists on one screen; Title, date and summary; Your own layout from TSconfig. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: The Records module shows news, contacts and products as the same rows of text.
Records List Types lets editors pick the view that suits each table.
The standard list stays one click away, with the columns you choose.
Compact view keeps long lists on one screen, with sortable columns.
Teaser view reads like a news list, with title, date and a short excerpt.
Catalogue is a custom view, built from TSconfig, a Fluid template and a stylesheet.
Records List Types. New views without PHP.
